purpose: Form MGT-1 is used by companies limited by shares to maintain a register of their members from the date of registration.
when: From the date of registration of the company
steps: Identify if the company is limited by shares or not having share capital.
For existing companies, transfer particulars from the old register under the Companies Act, 1956 to the new register in Form MGT-1.
Add any additional information required by the Act and rules as and when provided by members.
checklist: Particulars available in the register of members maintained under the Companies Act, 1956
Additional information provided by members as required by the Act and rules
Member name, address, e-mail address, Permanent Account Number or CIN, and Unique Identification Number if any
Father's, Mother's, or Spouse's name, Occupation, Status, and Nationality
Guardian name and date of birth if the member is a minor
Name and address of nominee, date of becoming member, date of cessation, amount of guarantee, and other interests
Instructions given by the member regarding sending of notices
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
